subject: KeyMetrics discovery — recap & next-step pulse
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin.lee@redwood.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 2 Apr 2027 15:07:00 -0700
Subject: KeyMetrics discovery — recap & next steps

Hi Alex / Priya,

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone has the same page and a suggested next step.

What you told us:
- Primary goals: reduce inference cost for the in-app assistant and lower tail latency for user queries (90th/99th percentile).
- Key workloads: document search/ranking for customer support + contextual assistant integrated in your web app.
- Constraints: customer data residency preference for US regions and SOC2 evidence for procurement.
- Timeline: evaluating vendor options over the next 4–8 weeks; decision window depends on pilot results.

What Redwood recommended (high level):
- Hosted API for fast time-to-value (pilot) with the option to move to Dedicated capacity if you'd need predictable throughput.
- Smart KV prefix caching to reduce cost on repeated queries and model variants for lower-latency read paths.
- We can provide SOC2 summary + redacted logs for the procurement checklist.

Proposed next steps:
1) 30-min technical deep dive with Ben (SE) to review sample request patterns and walk through a pilot plan.
2) Redwood to share a short one-page latency/cost sketch and a 2-week pilot checklist so you can validate fit.

I attached a one-page Discovery-Recap and included a tentative pilot outline. If that sounds OK, pick a time here: https://calendly.com/redwood/30min or suggest two windows next week.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Sooyin Lee
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
soojin.lee@redwood.com | (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference
